diagram_previews.alt: Equilateral triangle ABC with the two angle trisectors from each vertex (blue from A, green from B, red from C) extended to the opposite sides; they bound a small shaded hexagon around the centre G; the 20 degree angle at A is marked.

Close-up of the shaded hexagon around G: the dashed vertical axis through G carries vertex V1 below G at distance d1 and vertex V4 above G at distance d2, and a dashed segment to a neighbouring vertex shows the 60 degree angle between consecutive vertex directions.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the symmetric description of the central hexagon (vertices alternately at two distances on the axes) and a product-to-sine simplification.
